instruction_units.title: 1. Ascending Scalar Run
instruction_units.instruction: The left hand moves stepwise up from Db2 to F3 at m.27, covering 16 semitones across 4 notes. Steps: +7, +5, +4.

instruction_units.title: 2. Melody with accompaniment
instruction_units.instruction: Both hands form a melody-with-accompaniment texture at m.27: one layer carries the melodic line while another supplies aligned support. Melody F4-Ab6 over accompaniment Db2.

instruction_units.title: 3. Melody Voicing over Accompaniment
instruction_units.instruction: The texture presents a melody voicing over accompaniment at m.27: the upper line projects while lower tones provide harmonic support. Melody F4-Ab6 over accompaniment Db2.
